trans-unit.target: 观众无需安装任何东西就能看到转盘吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Publish the wheel as a read-only public link and anyone can open it in a browser, with no account. It is also what you share after the draw as a record of the entries.
trans-unit.target: 可以。把转盘发布为只读公开链接，任何人都能在浏览器中打开，无需账号。抽奖结束后也可以分享它，作为参与名单的记录。

trans-unit.source: What to Eat Wheel | Random Food Picker
trans-unit.target: 吃什么转盘 | 随机美食选择器

trans-unit.source: Nobody can decide where to eat? Spin the food wheel and dinner is settled. A free random meal picker you can fill with your own restaurants and dishes.
trans-unit.target: 不知道去哪儿吃？转动美食转盘，晚餐马上定下。免费的随机选餐工具，可以填入你自己的餐厅和菜品。

trans-unit.source: "I don’t mind, you choose" is how a group loses half an hour. Put the options on a wheel, spin it once, and the question is closed — including for the person who said they did not mind.
trans-unit.target: “我都行，你定吧”——一群人就这样浪费半小时。把选项放上转盘，转一次，问题就结束了，连那个说“都行”的人也没话说。

trans-unit.source: Fill it with your actual options

The default wheel has the usual suspects, but it gets useful when you replace them with the eight places that actually deliver to you, or the meals you have ingredients for. Keep one wheel for weeknights and another for takeaway and switch between them — both stay saved on your device.
trans-unit.target: 默认转盘里是常见的选项，但换成真正能送到你家的八家店、或者你手头有食材的菜，它才真正好用。可以准备一个工作日转盘和一个外卖转盘，随时切换——两个都会保存在你的设备上。

trans-unit.source: Spinning in front of everyone is the point: nobody has to be the one who decided, so nobody gets blamed for the choice. Add a "someone else picks" slice if you want an escape hatch, and remove options that got vetoed before you spin.
trans-unit.target: 当着大家的面转才是关键：没人需要做那个拍板的人，也就没人因为选择而挨骂。想留条退路，就加一个“换人来选”的扇区；被否决的选项，转之前删掉即可。

trans-unit.source: Can I save my own list of restaurants?
trans-unit.target: 可以保存我自己的餐厅列表吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Copy the wheel, replace the entries with your own, and it stays on your device for next time. Signing in is optional and only needed to reach the same wheel from another device.
trans-unit.target: 可以。复制转盘，把条目换成你自己的，它会保存在你的设备上供下次使用。登录是可选的，只有想在其他设备上打开同一个转盘时才需要。

trans-unit.source: How many options can the food wheel hold?
trans-unit.target: 美食转盘最多能放多少个选项？

trans-unit.source: Far more than a dinner decision needs. Past roughly a dozen the labels get tight, so a wheel of eight to ten options is the sweet spot for readability.
trans-unit.target: 远超决定晚餐所需。超过十几个后标签会变得拥挤，所以八到十个选项在可读性上最理想。

trans-unit.source: Random Team Generator | Free Group & Name Picker
trans-unit.target: 随机分组生成器 | 免费分组与点名工具

trans-unit.source: Split a group into teams or pick a random person without the arguing. A free random team generator for classrooms, standups, workshops and game nights.
trans-unit.target: 把一群人分组，或随机点一个人，不用争论。适用于课堂、站会、工作坊和游戏之夜的免费随机分组工具。

trans-unit.source: Picking teams by hand always ends with someone chosen last. A wheel removes the judgement from it: spin, read the name, move on to the next pick — and nobody can argue with a result nobody controlled.
trans-unit.target: 手动选队总会有人被留到最后。转盘把主观判断拿掉：转一下，念出名字，继续下一轮——没人能质疑一个谁都没操控的结果。

trans-unit.source: Teams, turns and who goes first

The same wheel covers most group decisions: split a class into groups, choose who presents first in a standup, pick the volunteer nobody wants to be, or decide the order of a tournament. Remove each name as it comes up and the wheel works through the whole group without repeats.
trans-unit.target: 同一个转盘能搞定大部分团体决策：把班级分组、决定站会上谁先汇报、选出没人想当的志愿者，或者排定比赛顺序。每抽中一个名字就移除，转盘就能不重复地轮完整个团队。

trans-unit.source: Paste a list of names in one go rather than typing them one by one, shuffle before you start, and spin. In a classroom or a workshop the whole thing takes less time than reading the names out loud, and the visible spin is what keeps a room of people watching.
trans-unit.target: 一次性粘贴名单，不用逐个输入，开始前打乱顺序，然后转动。在课堂或工作坊里，整个过程比念一遍名字还快，看得见的旋转也能牢牢吸引全场注意力。

trans-unit.source: Can I stop the same person being picked twice?
trans-unit.target: 能避免同一个人被抽中两次吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Turn on removing the winner after each spin and every name is drawn at most once, so consecutive spins work through the group instead of repeating.
trans-unit.target: 可以。开启“每次转动后移除得主”，每个名字最多被抽中一次，连续转动时会轮遍整个团队而不会重复。

trans-unit.source: Can I run more than one team wheel at a time?
trans-unit.target: 可以同时运行多个分组转盘吗？

trans-unit.source: Up to four wheels can be shown side by side, each with its own entries — useful when you are drawing from separate pools, such as one wheel per team.
trans-unit.target: 最多可以并排显示四个转盘，每个都有自己的条目——从不同名单中抽取时很实用，比如每个团队一个转盘。

trans-unit.source: Truth or Dare Wheel | Free Party Game Spinner
trans-unit.target: 真心话大冒险转盘 | 免费聚会游戏

trans-unit.source: A free truth or dare wheel for parties and game nights. Spin to decide, or fill it with your own truths and dares and let the wheel run the game.
trans-unit.target: 适合聚会和游戏之夜的免费真心话大冒险转盘。转一下来决定，或者填入你自己的真心话和大冒险，让转盘主持游戏。

trans-unit.source: The wheel does the part of truth or dare that nobody wants to do: choosing. Nobody picks on anybody, nobody goes easy on their friends, and the game keeps moving because there is nothing to negotiate.
trans-unit.target: 转盘替你完成真心话大冒险里最没人想做的事：选择。没人针对谁，也没人偏袒朋友，游戏一直进行下去，因为没有什么好讨价还价的。

trans-unit.source: Keep the wheel simple — truth or dare, spin per player — or write the actual challenges on the slices so the wheel hands out the dare itself. The second version is better for larger groups, where thinking of a new dare every turn is what slows the game down.
trans-unit.target: 可以让转盘保持简单——真心话或大冒险，每位玩家转一次；也可以把具体挑战写在扇区上，让转盘直接派发任务。第二种更适合人多的时候，因为每轮现想新挑战正是拖慢游戏的原因。

trans-unit.source: Set the tone before you spin

Copy the wheel and write your own entries, which is also how you keep the game appropriate for who is playing. A wheel written in advance by the whole group avoids the moment where one person invents a dare that goes too far.
trans-unit.target: 复制转盘并写上你们自己的条目，这也是让游戏适合在场玩家的方式。由全组提前一起写好的转盘，能避免有人临场想出过火的挑战。

trans-unit.source: Can I write my own truths and dares?
trans-unit.target: 可以写我自己的真心话和大冒险吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes — copy the wheel and replace the entries with anything you like. Your version is saved on your device, so the same wheel is ready for the next game night.
trans-unit.target: 可以——复制转盘，把条目换成任何你想要的内容。你的版本保存在设备上，下次游戏之夜同一个转盘随时可用。

trans-unit.source: Does it work on a phone passed around the group?
trans-unit.target: 在大家传着用的手机上好用吗？

trans-unit.source: It does. The wheel is designed for touch, fills the screen on a phone, and the interface can be hidden so only the wheel is visible while you play.
trans-unit.target: 好用。转盘为触屏设计，在手机上铺满屏幕，还能隐藏界面，游戏时只显示转盘。

trans-unit.source: Discount Wheel | Free Spin-to-Win Promo Wheel
trans-unit.target: 折扣转盘 | 免费转一转赢优惠促销转盘

trans-unit.source: A free spin-to-win discount wheel for shops, market stalls and promos. Put your offers on the wheel and let customers spin for their own discount.
trans-unit.target: 免费的“转一转赢优惠”折扣转盘，适合店铺、市集摊位和促销活动。把优惠放上转盘，让顾客自己转出折扣。
转一转赢优惠折扣转盘

trans-unit.source: A discount someone won feels different from a discount they were given. Put your offers on the wheel, let the customer spin it themselves, and a routine promotion turns into thirty seconds of attention.
trans-unit.target: 赢来的折扣和送出的折扣感觉完全不同。把优惠放上转盘，让顾客亲手转动，一次普通的促销就变成了三十秒的专注时刻。

trans-unit.source: For a counter, a stall or a stand

Run it on a tablet at the till, on a laptop at a trade stand, or on a screen behind a market stall. Everything lives in the browser and the Android app works offline, which matters at an event where the venue wi-fi does not.
trans-unit.target: 可以在收银台的平板上、展会的笔记本上，或者市集摊位后的屏幕上运行。一切都在浏览器里完成，安卓应用还能离线使用——在场地 Wi-Fi 不给力的活动中尤其重要。

trans-unit.source: Control what you are giving away

The odds are the slices: make the deep discount one slice out of twelve and the small ones repeat. Adding a "next time" or "free shipping" slice keeps the wheel honest while capping what a single spin can cost you.
trans-unit.target: 概率就是扇区：让大额折扣只占十二个扇区中的一个，小额折扣重复出现。加一个“下次再来”或“免运费”的扇区，既让转盘保持诚实，又能限制单次转动的成本。

trans-unit.source: Can I control how often the big discount comes up?
trans-unit.target: 能控制大额折扣出现的频率吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes, through the slices themselves. Every slice of equal size has an equal chance, so repeating the smaller offers and leaving one slice for the big one sets the odds exactly.
trans-unit.target: 可以，通过扇区本身来控制。大小相同的扇区概率相同，所以重复小额优惠、只给大额优惠留一个扇区，就能精确设定概率。

trans-unit.source: Can I brand the wheel for my shop?
trans-unit.target: 可以把转盘做成我店铺的风格吗？

trans-unit.source: Colours, background, fonts, a centre logo and the sounds are all replaceable, so the wheel can be made to match your shop rather than looking like a generic tool.
trans-unit.target: 颜色、背景、字体、中心徽标和声音都可以替换，让转盘与你的店铺风格一致，而不像一个通用工具。

trans-unit.source: What to Watch Wheel | Random Movie Picker
trans-unit.target: 看什么转盘 | 随机选片工具

trans-unit.source: Stop scrolling and start watching. A free random movie picker: put the shortlist on the wheel, spin once, and the film is chosen for the night.
trans-unit.target: 别再刷了，开始看吧。免费的随机选片工具：把候选片单放上转盘，转一次，今晚的电影就定了。

trans-unit.source: The half hour spent scrolling for something to watch is longer than the argument it was meant to avoid. Put the shortlist on a wheel, spin it, and the evening starts.
trans-unit.target: 花半小时刷片找东西看，比它本想避免的争论还要久。把候选片单放上转盘，转一下，夜晚就开始了。
候选片单胜过整个片库

trans-unit.source: The wheel works best with the six or eight films everyone has already agreed they would accept. That is the real trick: the wheel is not choosing from everything, it is closing a list you have already narrowed down, which is the part a group cannot finish on its own.
trans-unit.target: 转盘最适合用在大家都已认可的六到八部电影上。这才是真正的诀窍：转盘不是从所有片子里挑，而是帮你们敲定已经缩小的片单——这恰恰是一群人自己完成不了的那一步。

trans-unit.source: Put genres on the wheel when nobody can even agree on a direction — spin once for the genre, then pick within it. The same wheel covers series nights, rewatches and the "something we have never seen" pile.
trans-unit.target: 如果连方向都定不下来，就把类型放上转盘——先转出类型，再在其中挑片。同一个转盘也适用于追剧之夜、重温老片，以及“从没看过的片子”清单。

trans-unit.source: Can I keep a list of films for next time?
trans-unit.target: 可以保存片单留着下次用吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Copy the wheel, edit the entries, and it is saved on your device. You can keep several wheels — one for films, one for series, one for the list nobody has watched yet.
trans-unit.target: 可以。复制转盘、编辑条目，它就会保存在你的设备上。你可以保留多个转盘——电影一个、剧集一个、还没人看过的片单一个。

trans-unit.source: Can everyone watching see the wheel?
trans-unit.target: 一起看片的人都能看到转盘吗？

trans-unit.source: Share it as a read-only public link and anyone can open the same wheel in their browser with no account, which is handy when the group is not in the same room.
trans-unit.target: 把它分享为只读公开链接，任何人都能在浏览器中打开同一个转盘，无需账号——大家不在同一个房间时特别方便。

trans-unit.source: Random Workout Generator | Free Exercise Wheel
trans-unit.target: 随机训练生成器 | 免费运动转盘

trans-unit.source: A free random workout generator: spin the wheel for your next exercise. Fill it with your own moves and let the wheel decide the order and the mix.
trans-unit.target: 免费的随机训练生成器：转动转盘决定下一个动作。填入你自己的动作，让转盘决定顺序和组合。

trans-unit.source: Training goes stale when you always pick the exercises you like. A wheel picks the ones you do not, keeps the session unpredictable, and removes the deciding from a moment when you would rather be resting.
trans-unit.target: 总挑自己喜欢的动作，训练很快就会变得乏味。转盘会挑你不爱做的，让每次训练都难以预料，还能在你只想歇口气时替你做决定。

trans-unit.source: Put the movements on the wheel and spin for the next one, or put durations and rep counts on a second wheel and spin both. Two wheels side by side — one for the exercise, one for the intensity — gives you a different session every time from the same list.
trans-unit.target: 把动作放上转盘，转出下一个；或者把时长和次数放在第二个转盘上，两个一起转。两个转盘并排——一个定动作、一个定强度——同一份清单每次都能组合出不同的训练。

trans-unit.source: Build it around what you have

Write your own entries so the wheel only offers exercises you can actually do in the space and with the kit you own. A bodyweight wheel for travelling and a gym wheel for everything else is the usual split, and both stay saved.
trans-unit.target: 写上你自己的条目，让转盘只给出你在现有空间和器材下真正能做的动作。常见做法是准备一个旅行用的徒手转盘和一个健身房转盘，两个都会保存下来。

trans-unit.source: Can I use it for HIIT or circuit training?
trans-unit.target: 可以用来做 HIIT 或循环训练吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. The countdown before each spin doubles as a rest timer, and removing each exercise after it comes up turns the wheel into a circuit that works through the whole list without repeats.
trans-unit.target: 可以。每次转动前的倒计时正好当作休息计时器；每个动作抽中后移除，转盘就变成一个不重复地做完整份清单的循环训练。

trans-unit.source: Does it work at the gym without a connection?
trans-unit.target: 在没有网络的健身房也能用吗？

trans-unit.source: The Android app works fully offline, so a saved wheel keeps spinning in a basement gym with no signal.
trans-unit.target: 安卓应用可完全离线使用，所以即使在没有信号的地下健身房，保存好的转盘照样能转。

trans-unit.source: Random Number Wheel | Free Number Picker Spinner
trans-unit.target: 随机数字转盘 | 免费抽数字工具

trans-unit.source: A free random number wheel: spin to draw a number in front of everyone. Set your own range for raffles, bingo, classroom picks and lotteries.
trans-unit.target: 免费的随机数字转盘：当着所有人的面抽一个数字。可自定义范围，适用于抽奖、宾果、课堂点名和彩票。

trans-unit.source: A number generator gives you a number. A wheel gives a room full of people a number they watched being drawn — which is what you need when the draw has to convince somebody other than you.
trans-unit.target: 随机数生成器给你一个数字。转盘则让满屋子的人看着一个数字被抽出来——当抽签结果需要让你以外的人信服时，这正是你需要的。

trans-unit.source: Raffle tickets, bingo calls, lottery-style draws, picking a seat or a locker: any time the number decides who gets something, being able to see it drawn matters more than the speed. The wheel slows the moment down deliberately, and the winners list keeps the order the numbers came out in.
trans-unit.target: 抽奖券、宾果叫号、彩票式抽签、分配座位或储物柜：只要数字决定谁得到什么，能亲眼看到抽取过程就比速度更重要。转盘有意放慢这一刻，得主列表还会记录数字出现的顺序。

trans-unit.source: Copy the wheel and replace the entries with whatever range you need — 1 to 20, ticket numbers, the numbers still in play. Remove each number after it is drawn and the wheel works through the range without repeating, which is exactly how a bingo caller uses it.
trans-unit.target: 复制转盘，把条目换成你需要的范围——1 到 20、奖券号码，或仍在局中的数字。每抽出一个就移除，转盘就会不重复地抽完整个范围，这正是宾果叫号员的用法。

trans-unit.source: How is this different from a random number generator?
trans-unit.target: 这和随机数生成器有什么不同？

trans-unit.source: The randomness is the same cryptographic source. The difference is that the draw is visible: everyone watching sees the same spin land on the same number, which a generator that prints a number cannot offer.
trans-unit.target: 随机性来自同样的加密随机源。区别在于抽取过程是可见的：所有观众都看到同一次转动停在同一个数字上，这是只输出数字的生成器做不到的。

trans-unit.source: Can I draw several numbers without repeats?
trans-unit.target: 可以不重复地抽多个数字吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Turn on removing the winner after each spin and each number is drawn at most once, so repeated spins work through the whole range.
trans-unit.target: 可以。开启“每次转动后移除得主”，每个数字最多被抽中一次，连续转动就能抽完整个范围。

trans-unit.source: Icebreaker Questions Wheel | Free Team Spinner
trans-unit.target: 破冰问题转盘 | 免费团队互动工具

trans-unit.source: A free icebreaker wheel for meetings, workshops and first days. Spin for a question, go round the room, and get a quiet group talking in two minutes.
trans-unit.target: 免费的破冰转盘，适用于会议、工作坊和入职第一天。转出一个问题，大家轮流回答，两分钟让安静的团队聊起来。

trans-unit.source: Icebreakers fail when the facilitator picks the question and everyone can tell it was picked. A wheel takes that away: the question arrives by chance, the room reacts to the wheel instead of to you, and the first answer comes faster.
trans-unit.target: 破冰活动失败，往往是因为主持人挑问题、而大家都看得出来。转盘能解决这一点：问题随机出现，大家对着转盘而不是对着你作出反应，第一个回答也来得更快。
适用于会议、入职培训和工作坊

trans-unit.source: Spin once at the top of a recurring meeting and go round the room, or spin per person so everybody gets a different question. It works the same on a projector in a room and shared on a call, and two minutes is usually all it needs to take.
trans-unit.target: 可以在例会开始时转一次，让大家轮流回答；也可以每人转一次，让每个人拿到不同的问题。无论投在会议室屏幕上还是在线上会议中共享，效果都一样，通常两分钟就够了。

trans-unit.source: Write questions your team would answer
trans-unit.target: 写你的团队愿意回答的问题

trans-unit.source: The stock questions are a starting point; the good version of this wheel is the one a team wrote themselves. Keep the questions light and answerable in a sentence — anything that needs a considered answer stops being an icebreaker and becomes a meeting.
trans-unit.target: 默认问题只是起点，这个转盘最好的版本是团队自己写的。问题要轻松、一句话能答完——需要深思熟虑才能回答的，就不再是破冰，而是开会了。

trans-unit.source: Does it work for remote teams?
Yes. Share your screen and spin, or publish the wheel as a public link so everyone on the call opens the same one in their own browser.
trans-unit.target: 可以。共享屏幕后转动，或者把转盘发布为公开链接，让会议里的每个人都在自己的浏览器中打开同一个转盘。

trans-unit.source: Can I use my own icebreaker questions?
trans-unit.target: 可以用我自己的破冰问题吗？

trans-unit.source: Copy the wheel and replace the entries with your own. The wheel is saved on your device, so the same set is ready for every following meeting.
trans-unit.target: 复制转盘，把条目换成你自己的问题。转盘保存在你的设备上，之后每次会议都能直接使用同一组问题。

trans-unit.source: Random Name Picker | Free Name Wheel Spinner
trans-unit.target: 随机点名器 | 免费名字转盘

trans-unit.source: A free random name picker for classrooms, meetings and calls. Paste your list, spin the wheel, and the name is chosen in front of everyone.
trans-unit.target: 免费的随机点名工具，适用于课堂、会议和线上通话。粘贴名单，转动转盘，当着所有人选出名字。

trans-unit.source: Calling on someone is the moment a room decides whether you are fair. A wheel takes the choice out of your hands: the name is drawn in front of everybody, so nobody is picked on and nobody is skipped.
trans-unit.target: 点名的那一刻，全场都在判断你是否公平。转盘让选择不再由你决定：名字当着所有人抽出，没人被针对，也没人被跳过。

trans-unit.source: Add the whole list in one go rather than typing names one at a time, shuffle it, and start spinning. A teacher can set this up between two lessons, and the same wheel stays saved for the rest of the term.
trans-unit.target: 一次性加入整份名单，不用逐个输入名字，打乱顺序后就能开转。老师在两节课之间就能设置好，同一个转盘整个学期都保存着。
不重复点名，或最终人人轮到

trans-unit.source: Remove each name after it is drawn and the wheel works through the class without repeats — which is how you make sure the quiet students get their turn too. Leave the names in and it stays a lottery, better for handing out a single prize.
trans-unit.target: 每抽中一个名字就移除，转盘便能不重复地轮完全班——这样也能确保安静的学生轮到发言。保留名字则仍是抽奖模式，更适合发放单个奖品。

trans-unit.source: How many names can the picker hold?
trans-unit.target: 点名器最多能放多少个名字？

trans-unit.source: A full class fits comfortably. Past roughly thirty entries the labels on the wheel get thin, so very long lists are easier to read split across a few wheels.
trans-unit.target: 一整个班级绰绰有余。超过大约三十个条目后，转盘上的标签会变窄，所以很长的名单分到几个转盘上更易读。

trans-unit.source: Can I stop a name from being picked twice?
trans-unit.target: 能避免同一个名字被抽中两次吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Turn on removing the winner after each spin and each name is drawn at most once, so consecutive spins work through the whole list.
trans-unit.target: 可以。开启“每次转动后移除得主”，每个名字最多被抽中一次，连续转动就能轮完整份名单。

trans-unit.source: Would You Rather Wheel | Free Question Spinner
trans-unit.target: 你宁愿转盘 | 免费问题生成器

trans-unit.source: A free would you rather wheel: spin for an impossible choice and make everyone defend their answer. Add your own questions in seconds.
trans-unit.target: 免费的“你宁愿”转盘：转出一个两难选择，让每个人为自己的答案辩护。几秒钟就能加入你自己的问题。

trans-unit.source: The hard part of would you rather is thinking of a question that nobody has heard before. Let the wheel hold the questions, and the game runs itself — spin, read it out, go round the group.
trans-unit.target: 玩“你宁愿”最难的是想出一个没人听过的问题。把问题交给转盘，游戏就能自己运转——转一下、读出来、大家轮流回答。

trans-unit.source: Good for a queue, a car or a classroom
trans-unit.target: 排队、开车或课堂都适用

trans-unit.source: It needs no setup and no props, which is why it works in the places where a game normally cannot start: waiting somewhere, a long drive, the last ten minutes of a lesson. One phone passed around is enough.
trans-unit.target: 不需要准备，也不需要道具，所以在平时开不了游戏的场合也能玩：排队等候、长途开车、下课前的最后十分钟。一部手机传着用就够了。

trans-unit.source: Write the questions for your group

Copy the wheel and replace the entries with dilemmas aimed at the people playing — in-jokes, work scenarios, questions only your friends would find funny. A wheel written by the group is always better than a generic list.
trans-unit.target: 复制转盘，把条目换成专为在场玩家设计的两难问题——圈内梗、职场情境、只有你朋友才懂笑点的问题。由大家一起写的转盘，永远比通用清单好玩。

trans-unit.source: Can I add my own would you rather questions?
trans-unit.target: 可以加入我自己的“你宁愿”问题吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Copy the wheel, replace the entries with your own, and your version is saved on your device for the next time you play.
trans-unit.target: 可以。复制转盘，换上你自己的条目，你的版本会保存在设备上，下次玩时直接用。

trans-unit.source: How do I keep it suitable for kids?
Write the wheel in advance with the questions you are happy with. Because the wheel only ever offers what is written on it, there are no surprises mid-game.
trans-unit.target: 提前把你认可的问题写进转盘。转盘只会给出上面写好的内容，游戏中途就不会有意外。

trans-unit.source: Never Have I Ever Wheel | Free Party Game Spinner
trans-unit.target: 我从来没有转盘 | 免费聚会游戏

trans-unit.source: A free never have I ever wheel for game nights. Spin for the prompt, see who owns up, and add your own statements whenever you like.
trans-unit.target: 免费的“我从来没有”游戏转盘，适合游戏之夜。转出题目，看谁会坦白，随时都能加入你自己的句子。

trans-unit.source: Never have I ever stalls the moment somebody has to invent the next statement. Put them on a wheel and the game keeps its rhythm: spin, read it out, watch who gives themselves away.
trans-unit.target: “我从来没有”一旦需要有人现编下一句就会卡壳。把句子放上转盘，游戏就能保持节奏：转一下、读出来、看谁露了馅。

trans-unit.source: Nobody has to run the game, which also means nobody can aim a statement at one person in particular. The wheel picking at random is what keeps it light — everyone is exposed by chance rather than by the person whose turn it was.
trans-unit.target: 没人需要主持游戏，也就没人能拿某句话专门针对某个人。转盘随机出题让气氛保持轻松——每个人都是被运气揭穿的，而不是被轮到出题的人。

trans-unit.source: The default statements are mild on purpose. Copy the wheel and write your own for the group you are playing with, and keep more than one version — a work-party wheel and a close-friends wheel are not the same list.
trans-unit.target: 默认句子故意写得很温和。复制转盘，为一起玩的人写你们自己的句子，还可以保留多个版本——公司聚会转盘和好友转盘可不是同一份清单。

trans-unit.source: How many players does it work with?
Any number. The wheel only picks the statement; how you score it — fingers down, points, forfeits — is up to the group.
trans-unit.target: 人数不限。转盘只负责出题，怎么计分——弯手指、记分还是受罚——由大家自己决定。

trans-unit.source: Can everyone see the wheel at once?
trans-unit.target: 所有人能同时看到转盘吗？

trans-unit.source: Share it as a read-only public link and everyone opens the same wheel in their own browser, or put one screen in the middle of the table.
trans-unit.target: 把它分享为只读公开链接，每个人在自己的浏览器里打开同一个转盘；或者在桌子中间放一块屏幕。

trans-unit.source: Chore Wheel | Free Chore Chart Spinner
trans-unit.target: 家务转盘 | 免费家务分配工具

trans-unit.source: A free chore wheel for housemates and families. Spin to assign the washing up, the bins and everything nobody volunteers for — without the argument.
trans-unit.target: 免费的家务转盘，适合室友和家庭。转一下就能分配洗碗、倒垃圾以及所有没人主动做的活——不用吵架。

trans-unit.source: Every shared house has the same argument, and it is never really about the dishes. A wheel settles it without anyone having to be the one who decided: spin, read the result, it is done.
trans-unit.target: 每个合租屋都在吵同一件事，而且从来都不只是为了洗碗。转盘能解决它，不需要任何人当那个拍板的人：转一下，看结果，搞定。

trans-unit.source: Chores or people — pick a side
trans-unit.target: 放家务还是放人——二选一

trans-unit.source: Put the chores on the wheel and spin once per person, or put the housemates on it and spin once per chore. The second version is better when one job is far worse than the others, because everybody watches that particular spin.
trans-unit.target: 把家务放上转盘、每人转一次，或者把室友放上去、每项家务转一次。如果某项活比其他的糟糕得多，第二种更好，因为所有人都会盯着那一次转动。

trans-unit.source: Add a "day off" slice so there is something to hope for, and remove each chore once it is assigned so the wheel shares out the whole list. Keep the wheel saved and re-spin it every Sunday — the routine is what stops the argument coming back.
trans-unit.target: 加一个“休息日”扇区，让大家有个盼头；每分配一项就移除，转盘就能把整份清单分完。把转盘保存好，每个周日重新转一次——正是这个习惯让争吵不再回来。

trans-unit.source: Can I add or remove chores?
Yes. Copy the wheel and edit the entries to match your household — the version you make is saved on your device.
trans-unit.target: 可以。复制转盘，按你家的情况编辑条目——你做的版本会保存在设备上。

trans-unit.source: Can I make one chore rarer than the others?
trans-unit.target: 能让某项家务比其他的更少出现吗？

trans-unit.source: The odds are just the slices. Repeat the chores you want to come up more often and leave the worst one as a single slice.
trans-unit.target: 概率就是扇区。把希望多出现的家务重复几次，最糟的那项只留一个扇区。

trans-unit.source: Secret Santa Wheel | Free Gift Exchange Name Draw
trans-unit.target: 神秘圣诞老人转盘 | 免费礼物交换抽签

trans-unit.source: Draw Secret Santa names with a wheel instead of a hat. Free, works for an office or a family, and everyone sees the draw happen.
trans-unit.target: 用转盘代替帽子来抽神秘圣诞老人的名字。免费，适用于办公室或家庭，每个人都能看到抽取过程。

trans-unit.source: A hat full of folded paper only works when everyone is in the same room. A wheel draws the names in front of whoever is watching — in the office, on a call, or in a group chat with the screen shared.
trans-unit.target: 装满折好纸条的帽子只有在大家同处一室时才管用。转盘则能在任何观看者面前抽出名字——无论是在办公室、视频通话中，还是共享屏幕的群聊里。

trans-unit.source: Put every participant on the wheel and spin once for each giver, removing each name as it comes out so nobody is assigned twice. The winners list keeps the order the names were drawn in, which is the record you check when somebody forgets who they had.
trans-unit.target: 把所有参与者放上转盘，每位送礼人转一次，抽中的名字随即移除，确保没人被分配两次。得主列表会记录抽出名字的顺序，有人忘了自己抽到谁时，就查这份记录。

trans-unit.source: The catch with a public draw is that it is public. For a genuinely secret exchange, spin privately for each person and tell them their name individually — the wheel is doing the randomising, not the announcing.
trans-unit.target: 公开抽签的问题就在于它是公开的。想要真正保密，就私下为每个人转一次，再单独告诉他们抽到的名字——转盘负责随机，而不是负责公布。

trans-unit.source: Can the wheel avoid pairing someone with themselves?
trans-unit.target: 转盘能避免有人抽到自己吗？

trans-unit.source: Remove the giver’s own name from the wheel before their spin, and remove each drawn name afterwards. That is the whole trick, and it takes a second per person.
trans-unit.target: 在送礼人转动前把他自己的名字从转盘上移除，抽完后再移除抽中的名字。诀窍就这么简单，每人只需一秒钟。
每个人都需要注册账号吗？

trans-unit.source: No. The wheel runs in any browser with no signup, and a read-only public link lets everyone watch the same one without signing in.
trans-unit.target: 不需要。转盘在任何浏览器中都能运行，无需注册；只读公开链接也能让所有人不登录就观看同一个转盘。

trans-unit.source: Random Letter Generator | Free A–Z Wheel
trans-unit.target: 随机字母生成器 | 免费 A–Z 转盘

trans-unit.source: A free random letter generator: spin the A to Z wheel for word games, categories, spelling practice and writing prompts.
trans-unit.target: 免费的随机字母生成器：转动 A–Z 转盘，用于文字游戏、分类接龙、拼写练习和写作灵感。

trans-unit.source: Twenty-six letters, one spin. It is the starting gun for half the word games ever invented — categories, Scattergories-style rounds, spelling practice, a writing prompt when the page is blank.
trans-unit.target: 二十六个字母，转一次。这是半数文字游戏的发令枪——分类接龙、类别抢答、拼写练习，或者面对空白页时的写作灵感。

trans-unit.source: For the games that need a letter
trans-unit.target: 适合需要一个字母的游戏

trans-unit.source: Name a country, an animal and a food starting with the letter it lands on; give a class a letter to spell words from; start a story with it. The wheel is doing something a generator also does, with the difference that everyone playing watched it land.
trans-unit.target: 说出以转到的字母开头的国家、动物和食物；给全班一个字母来拼单词；或者用它开头写一个故事。转盘做的事生成器也能做，区别在于所有玩家都亲眼看到它停在哪里。

trans-unit.source: Copy the wheel and remove Q, X and Z if the game keeps grinding to a halt on them — or keep them and make them worth double. Vowels only, consonants only and a shortened alphabet for younger children are all a few edits away.
trans-unit.target: 如果游戏总卡在 Q、X、Z 上，复制转盘把它们删掉——或者保留它们并让它们双倍计分。只要元音、只要辅音，或者给小朋友用的简化字母表，改几下就行。
26 个字母出现的概率相同吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes, every letter is one slice of the same size, and the spin uses a cryptographic random source. No letter is weighted unless you add it twice.
trans-unit.target: 相同。每个字母占一个同样大小的扇区，转动使用加密随机源。除非你把某个字母加两次，否则没有字母被加权。

trans-unit.source: The letters look small — can I make them bigger?
trans-unit.target: 字母看起来很小——能放大吗？

trans-unit.source: Twenty-six slices is a lot for one wheel. Removing letters you do not need makes the rest larger, and the linear and card views show the same wheel with more room for each label.
trans-unit.target: 一个转盘放二十六个扇区确实很多。删掉不需要的字母，其余的就会变大；线性视图和卡片视图也能以更宽敞的空间展示同一个转盘的每个标签。

trans-unit.source: Random Country Wheel | Free Country Picker
trans-unit.target: 随机国家转盘 | 免费国家抽选工具

trans-unit.source: A free random country picker: spin the wheel for geography lessons, quiz rounds, travel ideas and language practice.
trans-unit.target: 免费的随机国家抽选工具：转动转盘，用于地理课、问答环节、旅行灵感和语言练习。

trans-unit.source: A random country is a lesson plan, a quiz round and a travel daydream in one spin. Put the ones you want on the wheel and let it choose where the conversation goes.
trans-unit.target: 一个随机国家，转一次就是一堂课、一轮问答和一场旅行白日梦。把你想要的国家放上转盘，让它决定话题的走向。

trans-unit.source: In a classroom or a pub quiz

Spin for the country a student has to present, the flag the table has to name, or the capital city nobody can remember. Narrow the wheel to one continent when the topic is narrower — a wheel of twelve African countries teaches more than a wheel of the whole world.
trans-unit.target: 转出学生要介绍的国家、全桌要认出的国旗，或者谁都想不起来的首都。主题更聚焦时，就把转盘缩小到一个大洲——十二个非洲国家的转盘比全世界的转盘更有教学价值。

trans-unit.source: Or for deciding where to go
The same wheel works as a travel shortlist when a group cannot agree. Put the countries you would actually visit on it, spin, and the discussion moves on from "where" to "when".
trans-unit.target: 当一群人意见不合时，同一个转盘也能当旅行候选清单。放上你们真的会去的国家，转一下，讨论就从“去哪儿”变成了“什么时候去”。

trans-unit.source: Can I choose which countries are on the wheel?
trans-unit.target: 可以自己选择转盘上的国家吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Copy the wheel and replace the entries with any list you like — a continent, the countries in a syllabus, or the five places on your shortlist.
trans-unit.target: 可以。复制转盘，把条目换成任意名单——某个大洲、教学大纲里的国家，或者你候选清单上的五个地方。

trans-unit.source: Can I show flags instead of names?
trans-unit.target: 可以显示国旗而不是国名吗？

trans-unit.source: Flag emoji work as entries, and each slice can also take its own image if you want the wheel to be pictures rather than words.
trans-unit.target: 国旗表情符号可以直接作为条目，每个扇区也可以设置自己的图片，让转盘显示图片而不是文字。

trans-unit.source: Random Animal Wheel | Free Animal Picker Spinner
trans-unit.target: 随机动物转盘 | 免费动物抽选工具

trans-unit.source: A free random animal generator for charades, drawing games and classrooms. Spin the wheel and act out, draw or describe whatever it lands on.
trans-unit.target: 免费的随机动物生成器，适用于猜字谜、画画游戏和课堂。转动转盘，把转到的动物演出来、画出来或描述出来。

trans-unit.source: Give a child a random animal and you have a game: act it out, draw it, make its noise, say three facts about it. The wheel is the part that keeps it fair and stops anyone choosing the easy one.
trans-unit.target: 给孩子一个随机动物，就是一个游戏：演出来、画出来、学它的叫声、说出三个知识点。转盘让游戏保持公平，谁也没法挑简单的。
猜字谜、画画和猜谜游戏

trans-unit.source: The wheel hands out the animal so the person whose turn it is does not get to pick something easy. It works the same for a class of thirty and for two children at a kitchen table, and needs nothing but a screen.
trans-unit.target: 由转盘分配动物，轮到的人就没法挑简单的。无论是三十人的班级，还是厨房桌边的两个孩子，玩法都一样，只需要一块屏幕。

trans-unit.source: Match it to what you are teaching

Copy the wheel and swap in the animals from the topic you are on — habitats, farm animals, minibeasts, the ones in the book you are reading. A wheel built around a lesson is worth more than a generic one.
trans-unit.target: 复制转盘，换成当前课题里的动物——栖息地、农场动物、小昆虫，或者正在读的书里的动物。围绕课程打造的转盘，比通用转盘更有价值。

trans-unit.source: Can I use pictures instead of names?
trans-unit.target: 可以用图片代替名称吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Each slice can carry its own image, which is what you want for children who are not reading yet.
trans-unit.target: 可以。每个扇区都能设置自己的图片，非常适合还不识字的孩子。

trans-unit.source: Can I make the wheel easier for younger children?
trans-unit.target: 能让转盘对年幼的孩子更简单吗？

trans-unit.source: Fewer entries means bigger slices and simpler choices. A six-animal wheel is easier to play with than a twenty-animal one.
trans-unit.target: 条目越少，扇区越大，选择也越简单。六种动物的转盘比二十种的更容易玩。

trans-unit.source: Date Night Ideas Wheel | Free Date Night Spinner
trans-unit.target: 约会点子转盘 | 免费情侣约会灵感

trans-unit.source: Out of date night ideas? Spin the wheel and let it plan the evening. Free, no signup, and you can fill it with the things you both actually want to do.
trans-unit.target: 约会没点子了？转动转盘，让它来安排今晚。免费、无需注册，还能填入你们俩真正想做的事。

trans-unit.source: "What do you want to do?" "I don’t mind." Two people who both do not mind will get to the end of the evening having done nothing. A wheel picks, and the evening starts on time.
trans-unit.target: “你想干什么？”“我都行。”两个都说“都行”的人，一晚上过去了什么也没做。让转盘来选，夜晚准时开始。

trans-unit.source: Put your own ideas on it

The stock ideas are a starting point; the wheel becomes useful when it holds the things you keep saying you should do and never book. Add the restaurant you walked past, the film neither of you has watched, the walk you meant to take.
trans-unit.target: 默认点子只是起点；当转盘装上你们总说该去做却从没预订的事情时，它才真正有用。加上你们路过的那家餐厅、两人都没看过的电影、一直想走的那段路。

trans-unit.source: Keep a cheap wheel and an expensive one
trans-unit.target: 准备一个省钱转盘和一个豪华转盘

trans-unit.source: One wheel for a free Tuesday and one for a proper night out is the split most couples land on. Both stay saved, so the choice is which wheel to spin rather than what to do.
trans-unit.target: 一个用于零花费的周二，一个用于正式的约会夜——大多数情侣最后都会这样分。两个都会保存，要选的只是转哪一个，而不是做什么。

trans-unit.source: Can we both see the same wheel?
trans-unit.target: 我们俩能看到同一个转盘吗？

trans-unit.source: Publish it as a read-only public link and it opens in any browser, on either phone, with no account needed.
trans-unit.target: 把它发布为只读公开链接，在任何浏览器、两部手机上都能打开，不需要账号。

trans-unit.source: Can I add ideas over time?
Yes — the wheel is editable whenever you like, so it grows as you think of things. It stays on your device, and signing in syncs it across your devices.
trans-unit.target: 可以——转盘随时都能编辑，想到什么就加什么。它保存在你的设备上，登录后还能在多台设备间同步。

trans-unit.source: Where to Travel Wheel | Random Destination Picker
trans-unit.target: 去哪儿旅行转盘 | 随机目的地选择器

trans-unit.source: A free random destination picker: put your travel shortlist on the wheel, spin, and stop rereading the same three tabs.
trans-unit.target: 免费的随机目的地选择器：把旅行候选清单放上转盘，转一下，别再反复翻看那三个网页了。

trans-unit.source: A travel shortlist that never gets shorter is not a shortlist. Put the places on a wheel, agree in advance that the spin decides, and the trip stops being a discussion and becomes a date in a calendar.
trans-unit.target: 一份永远缩不短的旅行候选清单，根本不算候选清单。把地点放上转盘，事先约定由转盘决定，旅行就不再是一场讨论，而是日历上的一个日期。

trans-unit.source: The wheel is not there to pick from every city on earth — it is there to close a list you have already agreed on. Six to ten places everyone would genuinely be happy with is the version that works; anything longer and somebody will want to re-spin.
trans-unit.target: 转盘不是用来从全世界的城市里挑的——而是用来敲定一份大家已经认可的清单。六到十个人人都真心满意的地方最合适；再多的话，总会有人想重转。
献给永远定不下来的团体

trans-unit.source: Group trips die in the planning. Spinning in front of everybody makes the decision collective without a vote, and nobody ends up responsible for the choice — which is usually the real reason nobody wants to make it.
trans-unit.target: 团体旅行往往死在规划阶段。当着大家的面转动转盘，不用投票就成了集体决定，也没人需要为选择负责——这通常才是没人愿意拍板的真正原因。

trans-unit.source: Can I weight the wheel towards cheaper destinations?
trans-unit.target: 能让转盘偏向便宜的目的地吗？

trans-unit.source: Add a place more than once and it takes more slices, so it comes up more often. That is all weighting is here.
trans-unit.target: 把某个地方加入不止一次，它就会占更多扇区，出现得更频繁。这里的加权就是这么简单。

trans-unit.source: Can I share the wheel with the people I am travelling with?
trans-unit.target: 可以和同行的人分享转盘吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. A read-only public link opens in any browser with no account, so everyone can see the shortlist and the spin.
trans-unit.target: 可以。只读公开链接无需账号即可在任何浏览器中打开，每个人都能看到候选清单和转动过程。

trans-unit.source: Instagram Giveaway Picker | Random Comment Winner Wheel
trans-unit.target: Instagram 抽奖转盘 | 从评论中随机抽取中奖者

trans-unit.source: Pick a random Instagram giveaway winner on camera: paste the usernames from the comments, spin the wheel, share the result. Free, no signup.
trans-unit.target: 当着镜头抽出 Instagram 抽奖的中奖者：粘贴评论中的用户名，转动转盘并分享结果。免费，无需注册。

trans-unit.source: Followers trust a draw they can see. Paste the usernames of everyone who entered, spin the wheel on a story or a live, and the winner is picked in front of the people who took part. The spin uses your browser’s cryptographic random source, so nobody — you included — can steer it.
trans-unit.target: 粉丝信任他们亲眼看到的抽奖。粘贴所有参与者的用户名，在快拍或直播中转动转盘，中奖者就在所有参与者面前产生。转盘使用浏览器的加密随机源，任何人——包括你自己——都无法操控结果。

trans-unit.source: From comments to wheel in a minute

Copy the usernames of valid entries, one per line, and paste the whole list into the wheel at once. Someone who earned extra entries — a tag, a share — simply goes on the list more than once and gets that many slices. The same list works for TikTok, Facebook or YouTube giveaways.
trans-unit.target: 复制有效参与者的用户名，每行一个，一次性粘贴到转盘中。获得额外抽奖机会的人（标记好友、分享）只需在列表中多出现几次，就会得到相应数量的扇区。同样的列表也适用于 TikTok、Facebook 或 YouTube 抽奖。

trans-unit.source: Record your screen while you spin, or let Wheelr do it: the winner card can save an image of the result or a short vertical video replaying the spin, ready for a story or a post announcing the winner.
trans-unit.target: 转动时录屏，或者交给 Wheelr：中奖卡片可以保存结果图片，或一段重放转动过程的竖屏短视频，直接用于快拍或公布中奖者的帖子。

trans-unit.source: Does Wheelr read the comments from Instagram automatically?
trans-unit.target: Wheelr 会自动读取 Instagram 评论吗？

trans-unit.source: No. Wheelr never connects to your Instagram account: you paste the usernames yourself, which also lets you remove entries that broke the rules before the draw. Wheelr is not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.
trans-unit.target: 不会。Wheelr 从不连接你的 Instagram 账户：用户名由你自己粘贴，这样你也可以在抽奖前移除违规的参与者。Wheelr 与 Instagram 或 Meta 无关联。

trans-unit.source: How do I pick more than one winner?
After each spin, remove the winner from the wheel and spin again. Every winner is added to the winners list, so the full result stays on screen.
trans-unit.target: 每次转动后，将中奖者从转盘中移除再转一次。每位中奖者都会加入中奖名单，完整结果会一直显示在屏幕上。

trans-unit.source: Who Pays Wheel | Decide Who Pays the Bill at Random
trans-unit.target: 谁买单转盘 | 随机决定谁付账单

trans-unit.source: Spin the who pays wheel to settle the coffee round or the dinner bill. Free, fair and fast — nobody can argue with a spin everyone watched.
trans-unit.target: 转动“谁买单”转盘，决定谁请这轮咖啡或付晚餐账单。免费、公平、快速——大家都看到的结果，没人能争辩。

trans-unit.source: The coffee round, the pizza order, the bill at the end of the night: someone has to pay, and nobody wants to be the one who suggests it should be them. Put everyone’s name on the wheel, spin it at the table, and the wheel takes the blame.
trans-unit.target: 一轮咖啡、点披萨、夜晚结束时的账单：总得有人付钱，但没人想主动说该自己付。把所有人的名字放上转盘，在桌上转一下，责任就交给转盘了。

trans-unit.source: A spin on a phone in the middle of the table is a decision the whole group saw happen. There is no hidden choice and no “you always pick me”: the result comes from your browser’s cryptographic random source and nobody can steer it.
trans-unit.target: 在桌子中间的手机上转一下，整个群体都亲眼看到了这个决定。没有暗箱操作，也没有“怎么又是我”：结果来自浏览器的加密随机源，没有人能操控。

trans-unit.source: For the office coffee run, remove whoever paid after each spin. The wheel shrinks until everyone has had a turn, then you put the names back and start again — a random rota that nobody has to keep track of.
trans-unit.target: 办公室买咖啡时，每次转动后移除已付钱的人。转盘越来越小，直到每个人都轮过一次，然后把名字放回去重新开始——一个无需任何人记录的随机轮值。

trans-unit.source: Can the same person lose twice in a row?
trans-unit.target: 同一个人会连续两次输吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes, if they stay on the wheel — every spin is independent. If you want a rotation instead, remove the winner after each spin so nobody pays again until everyone has.
trans-unit.target: 会的，只要这个人还在转盘上——每次转动都是独立的。如果想轮流，每次转动后移除中奖者，这样在所有人都付过之前没人会再付。

trans-unit.source: Does it work offline, at a restaurant?
trans-unit.target: 在餐厅没网时也能用吗？

trans-unit.source: The Android app works without a connection. On the web, the page keeps working once it has loaded, and your wheel stays saved on the device.
trans-unit.target: Android 应用无需联网即可使用。在网页上，页面加载后即可继续使用，转盘会保存在你的设备上。

trans-unit.source: Classroom Reward Wheel | Free Prize Spinner for Teachers
trans-unit.target: 课堂奖励转盘 | 教师免费奖励转盘

trans-unit.source: A free classroom reward wheel for teachers: rewards that cost nothing, picked by a spin on the board. Edit the prizes and reuse the wheel all year.
trans-unit.target: 免费的课堂奖励转盘：零成本奖励，在黑板上转一下选出。可编辑奖品，全年重复使用。

trans-unit.source: A reward is more exciting when nobody knows which one is coming. Put the classroom’s favourite privileges on the wheel, project it on the board, and let the student who earned it spin. The whole class watches, and the prize costs nothing.
trans-unit.target: 当没人知道会得到哪个奖励时，奖励才更令人兴奋。把全班最喜欢的特权放上转盘，投影到黑板上，让赢得奖励的学生来转。全班一起看，而奖品一分钱都不用花。

trans-unit.source: Choosing the class game, being DJ for the lesson, sitting at the teacher’s desk: privileges work as well as prizes and never run out. Swap the stock rewards for the ones your class actually asks for — the wheel is yours to edit.
trans-unit.target: 选择班级游戏、在课上当 DJ、坐在讲台上：特权和奖品一样有效，而且永远用不完。把示例奖励换成你的班级真正想要的——转盘由你随意编辑。

trans-unit.source: Keep a separate wheel for each class or age group; they all stay saved in your browser, and signing in syncs them between the classroom computer and your own. Nothing is shared unless you publish a link.
trans-unit.target: 为每个班级或年龄段单独保存一个转盘；它们都保存在浏览器中，登录后可在教室电脑和你自己的电脑之间同步。除非你发布链接，否则不会共享任何内容。

trans-unit.source: Do students need an account to use it?
No. The wheel runs in the teacher’s browser with no account and no student data. To let students open it on their own devices, publish it as a read-only link.
trans-unit.target: 不需要。转盘在老师的浏览器中运行，无需账户，也不涉及学生数据。若想让学生在自己的设备上打开，可将其发布为只读链接。

trans-unit.source: Can I make some rewards rarer than others?
trans-unit.target: 可以让某些奖励更稀有吗？

trans-unit.source: Add the common rewards more than once and they take more slices, so they come up more often. A reward that appears only once is the rare one.
trans-unit.target: 把常见奖励多添加几次，它们会占据更多扇区，出现得更频繁。只出现一次的奖励就是稀有奖励。

trans-unit.source: Fantasy Draft Order Generator | Random Draft Order Wheel
trans-unit.target: 梦幻选秀顺序生成器 | 随机选秀顺序转盘

trans-unit.source: Randomize your fantasy football draft order live: put every team on the wheel, spin until it is empty, and share the result with the league.
trans-unit.target: 现场随机决定梦幻联赛的选秀顺序：把所有队伍放上转盘，一直转到清空，再把结果分享给联赛。

trans-unit.source: Nothing starts a league season with more suspicion than a draft order the commissioner “randomized” on their own. Put every team on the wheel, spin it on the group call, and the order is settled in front of every manager.
trans-unit.target: 没有什么比联盟管理员独自“随机”出的选秀顺序更让人起疑了。把所有队伍放上转盘，在群组通话中转动，顺序就在所有经理面前确定。

trans-unit.source: Turn on removing the winner, then spin: the first team drawn gets the first pick and leaves the wheel. Keep spinning until the wheel is empty. The winners list keeps the order on screen as it builds up, ready to screenshot.
trans-unit.target: 开启“移除中奖者”后开始转动：第一个抽中的队伍获得第一顺位并离开转盘。一直转到转盘清空。中奖名单会在屏幕上逐步显示顺序，方便截图。

trans-unit.source: Replace the team placeholders with your managers’ names or team names. It works the same for fantasy football, basketball, baseball or any league with a draft — and for the calling order of an auction draft too.
trans-unit.target: 把示例队伍换成经理或队伍的名字。它同样适用于梦幻足球、篮球、棒球或任何有选秀的联赛——也适用于拍卖选秀的叫价顺序。

trans-unit.source: How do I prove the draft order was random?
trans-unit.target: 如何证明选秀顺序是随机的？

trans-unit.source: Spin it live on a video call or a stream, or save a short video of each spin from the winner card and post it in the league chat. Every spin uses your browser’s cryptographic random source.
trans-unit.target: 在视频通话或直播中现场转动，或者从中奖卡片保存每次转动的短视频并发到联赛群聊。每次转动都使用浏览器的加密随机源。

trans-unit.source: Can the whole league see the wheel?
trans-unit.target: 整个联赛都能看到这个转盘吗？

trans-unit.source: Publish it as a read-only public link and anyone can open it in a browser, with no account, to check the teams on it before the draw.
trans-unit.target: 将其发布为只读公开链接，任何人无需账户即可在浏览器中打开，在抽签前核对上面的队伍。

trans-unit.source: Random Color Wheel | Spin for a Random Color
trans-unit.target: 随机颜色转盘 | 转出一个随机颜色

trans-unit.source: Spin the random color wheel for art challenges, outfit games, party themes and classroom activities. Each slice is painted the color it names.
trans-unit.target: 转动随机颜色转盘，用于艺术挑战、穿搭游戏、派对主题和课堂活动。每个扇区都涂成它所写的颜色。

trans-unit.source: Draw it in this color, wear something this color, find an object this color before the timer runs out. A color picked at random is the start of a surprising number of games, and every slice on this wheel is painted in the color it names.
trans-unit.target: 用这个颜色画、穿一件这个颜色的衣服、在计时结束前找到一个这个颜色的物品。随机选出的颜色可以开启许多游戏，而这个转盘的每个扇区都涂成它所写的颜色。

trans-unit.source: Games that start with a color
trans-unit.target: 从一种颜色开始的游戏

trans-unit.source: Art challenges with one color only, a scavenger hunt for something that matches, a party dress code decided on the day, a sorting game for younger children learning their colors. The wheel supplies the constraint; the fun is in what people do with it.
trans-unit.target: 只用一种颜色的艺术挑战、寻找同色物品的寻宝游戏、当天才决定的派对着装要求、给正在学颜色的小朋友玩的分类游戏。转盘给出限制，乐趣在于大家如何发挥。

trans-unit.source: Copy the wheel and change it: pastels only, the colors of a brand, the paints you actually own. You can set the color of each slice yourself, so the wheel always shows the color it will pick.
trans-unit.target: 复制转盘并修改：只用粉彩色、某个品牌的颜色、你真正拥有的颜料。你可以自己设置每个扇区的颜色，让转盘始终显示它将选出的颜色。

trans-unit.source: Can I use hex codes instead of color names?
trans-unit.target: 可以用十六进制色值代替颜色名称吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. An entry is just text, so “#FF5733” works as well as “Orange”; set that slice to the same color and the wheel shows exactly what it picked.
trans-unit.target: 可以。条目只是文字，所以“#FF5733”和“橙色”一样可用；把该扇区设为同样的颜色，转盘就会准确显示选中的颜色。
每种颜色的概率都一样吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes — all slices are the same size and the spin uses your browser’s cryptographic random source. Add a color twice to make it come up more often.
trans-unit.target: 是的——所有扇区大小相同，转动使用浏览器的加密随机源。把某个颜色添加两次，它就会更常出现。

trans-unit.source: What to Draw Wheel | Random Drawing Prompt Generator
trans-unit.target: 画什么转盘 | 随机绘画主题生成器

trans-unit.source: Stuck on what to draw? Spin the wheel for a random drawing prompt and start sketching. Add your own ideas and keep a wheel for every sketchbook.
trans-unit.target: 不知道画什么？转动转盘获得随机绘画主题，马上开始画。添加你自己的点子，为每本速写本准备一个转盘。

trans-unit.source: The hardest part of drawing is often deciding what to draw. Spin the wheel, accept whatever it lands on, and the blank page stops being a choice and becomes a starting point.
trans-unit.target: 画画最难的部分往往是决定画什么。转动转盘，接受它给出的结果，白纸就不再是一个选择题，而是一个起点。

trans-unit.source: The stock prompts are a warm-up. Replace them with the things you want to practise — hands, reflections, a character from your comic — or build a themed wheel for a month of daily sketches.
trans-unit.target: 示例主题只是热身。把它们换成你想练习的内容——手、倒影、你漫画里的角色——或者做一个主题转盘，用于一个月的每日速写。

trans-unit.source: Show up to four wheels side by side: one for the subject, one for the style, one for the color. “A lighthouse, in ink, only blue” is a far better prompt than any single list can give you.
trans-unit.target: 最多可并排显示四个转盘：一个选主题，一个选风格，一个选颜色。“一座灯塔，用墨水画，只用蓝色”比任何单一列表给出的主题都好得多。

trans-unit.source: Is it good for art classes?
Yes. Project it on the board and spin once for the whole class, or publish it as a link so every student can spin their own prompt. No accounts are needed.
trans-unit.target: 适合。把它投影到黑板上为全班转一次，或者发布为链接，让每个学生转出自己的主题。无需账户。

trans-unit.source: Can I avoid getting the same prompt twice?
trans-unit.target: 可以避免抽到重复的主题吗？

trans-unit.source: Remove the prompt after you draw it and the wheel only offers the ones you have not done yet.
trans-unit.target: 画完后把该主题移除，转盘就只会给出你还没画过的主题。

trans-unit.source: Spin the Bottle Online | Free Spin the Bottle Wheel
trans-unit.target: 在线转瓶子 | 免费转瓶子转盘

trans-unit.source: Play spin the bottle online with a free wheel: add the players’ names, spin, and see who it points to. Works on any phone, no bottle and no signup.
trans-unit.target: 用免费转盘在线玩转瓶子：添加玩家名字，转动转盘，看看指向谁。任何手机都能用，无需瓶子，无需注册。

trans-unit.source: The party classic, minus the bottle rolling under the sofa. Put everyone’s name on the wheel, set the phone in the middle of the circle and spin. It stops on one name, clearly, with no arguing about which way the neck was pointing.
trans-unit.target: 派对经典游戏，不用担心瓶子滚到沙发底下。把所有人的名字放上转盘，把手机放在圆圈中间转一下。它会清楚地停在一个名字上，不用再争论瓶口到底指向谁。

trans-unit.source: The wheel only picks a person; what happens next is up to the group. Truth or dare, a question, a compliment, a silly challenge — pair it with another wheel of tasks and let two spins decide who does what.
trans-unit.target: 转盘只负责选出一个人，接下来做什么由大家决定。真心话大冒险、一个问题、一句赞美、一个搞笑挑战——再配一个任务转盘，让两次转动决定谁做什么。

trans-unit.source: Nobody gets picked twice in a row
Remove whoever was picked after each spin and everyone gets a turn before anyone goes again. Put the names back when the wheel is empty and the next round starts.
trans-unit.target: 每次转动后移除被选中的人，这样在任何人重复之前每个人都会轮到。转盘空了之后，把名字放回去，开始下一轮。

trans-unit.source: Can I play spin the bottle online with friends on a call?
trans-unit.target: 可以和朋友在视频通话中在线玩转瓶子吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Share your screen, or publish the wheel as a read-only link so everyone can watch the same wheel in their own browser.
trans-unit.target: 可以。共享屏幕，或者把转盘发布为只读链接，让每个人都在自己的浏览器中看到同一个转盘。

trans-unit.source: How many players can I add?
As many as you like — paste the whole list at once. With large groups each name just gets a thinner slice.
trans-unit.target: 想加多少都行——一次粘贴整份名单即可。人数多时，每个名字的扇区只是更窄一些。

trans-unit.source: Random Zodiac Sign Wheel | Spin for a Star Sign
trans-unit.target: 随机星座转盘 | 转出一个星座

trans-unit.source: Spin the zodiac wheel for a random star sign: all twelve signs, from Aries to Pisces. Free for party games, writing prompts, quizzes and classrooms.
trans-unit.target: 转动星座转盘随机选出一个星座：从白羊座到双鱼座，全部十二个。免费用于游戏、写作灵感、问答和课堂。

trans-unit.source: Twelve signs, one spin. Use it to give a character a star sign, to pick the next horoscope to read aloud, or to run a quiz round where everyone has to guess the dates. Every sign has the same chance of coming up.
trans-unit.target: 十二个星座，一次转动。可以用它给角色定一个星座、选出下一个要朗读的星座运势，或者进行一轮大家猜日期的问答。每个星座出现的概率都一样。

trans-unit.source: Guess the dates of the sign, name a famous person born under it, or act out its symbol. For writers, a random sign is a quick way to decide how a character sees the world before you know anything else about them.
trans-unit.target: 猜这个星座的日期范围、说出一位这个星座的名人，或者用动作表演它的符号。对写作者来说，随机星座是在了解角色其他信息之前，快速决定其世界观的方法。

trans-unit.source: Each sign takes one slice of the same size, and the spin uses your browser’s cryptographic random source. Remove a sign after it comes up to go through all twelve without repeats.
trans-unit.target: 每个星座占一个同样大小的扇区，转动使用浏览器的加密随机源。某个星座出现后将其移除，就能不重复地轮完全部十二个。

trans-unit.source: No — the wheel picks a sign at random, it does not predict anything. What you do with the sign is up to you.
trans-unit.target: 不是——转盘只是随机选出一个星座，并不预测任何事情。怎么用由你决定。

trans-unit.source: Can I add the Chinese zodiac animals instead?
Yes. Copy the wheel and replace the entries with the twelve animals, or any other list you like.
trans-unit.target: 可以。复制转盘，把条目换成十二生肖，或任何其他列表。

trans-unit.source: Baby Name Generator Wheel | Pick From Your Shortlist
trans-unit.target: 宝宝取名转盘 | 从候选名单中选择

trans-unit.source: Stuck between baby names? Put your shortlist on the wheel and spin. A free baby name picker that helps you notice which name you were hoping for.
trans-unit.target: 在几个宝宝名字之间犹豫不决？把候选名单放上转盘转一下。免费帮你发现自己心里真正期待的那个名字。

trans-unit.source: Choosing a name can go on for months. Put the names you both like on the wheel and spin: the useful part is often not the result, but the moment it lands and you realise whether you were hoping for that name or another one.
trans-unit.target: 取名字可能要纠结好几个月。把你们俩都喜欢的名字放上转盘转一下：有用的往往不是结果本身，而是转盘停下的那一刻，你会发现自己期待的是这个名字还是另一个。
你们的名单，而不是我们的

trans-unit.source: The names on the wheel are just an example. Replace them with your own shortlist — first names, middle names, or combinations of both — and keep separate wheels for different ideas.
trans-unit.target: 转盘上的名字只是示例。换成你们自己的候选名单——名字、中间名或组合都可以——不同的想法可以分别保存成不同的转盘。

trans-unit.source: Publish the wheel as a read-only link and grandparents or friends can spin it from their own phone. It is a gentle way to share a shortlist without asking everyone to vote.
trans-unit.target: 把转盘发布为只读链接，祖父母或朋友就能在自己的手机上转。这是分享候选名单的温和方式，不用让每个人投票。

trans-unit.source: Should we really let a wheel choose our baby’s name?
trans-unit.target: 真的要让转盘来决定宝宝的名字吗？

trans-unit.source: Only if you want to. Most parents use it to break a tie or to see how they feel when a name comes up — the decision stays yours.
trans-unit.target: 只有你们愿意时才这么做。大多数父母用它来打破僵局，或者感受某个名字出现时的心情——最终决定仍然由你们做。

trans-unit.source: Can I give our favourite name better odds?
trans-unit.target: 可以让我们最喜欢的名字概率更高吗？

trans-unit.source: Add it more than once and it gets more slices, so it comes up more often.
trans-unit.target: 把它多添加几次，它会占据更多扇区，出现得更频繁。

trans-unit.source: Pet Name Generator Wheel | Name Your Dog or Cat
trans-unit.target: 宠物取名转盘 | 给狗狗或猫咪取名

trans-unit.source: A free pet name generator wheel: spin for a name for your new puppy, kitten or rabbit, or put your family’s ideas on it and let the wheel settle it.
trans-unit.target: 免费宠物取名转盘：为新来的小狗、小猫或兔子转出一个名字，或者放上家人的点子，让转盘来决定。

trans-unit.source: A new pet arrives and everybody in the house has a different favourite name. Put all the ideas on the wheel, spin it together, and the name is picked fairly — which matters when the children are the ones voting.
trans-unit.target: 新宠物来了，家里每个人喜欢的名字都不一样。把所有点子放上转盘一起转，名字就能公平地选出来——当孩子们也参与投票时，这点尤其重要。

trans-unit.source: Let each member of the family add their favourite, then spin. Nobody wins the argument; the wheel does. If the result falls flat, remove it and spin again — it is your pet, after all.
trans-unit.target: 让每位家庭成员都添加自己最喜欢的名字，然后转动。谁也没赢得争论，赢的是转盘。如果结果不满意，移除后再转一次——毕竟这是你们的宠物。

trans-unit.source: The stock names are some of the most popular for dogs and cats. Replace them with names that suit your animal: food names, famous characters, or something to do with where you found them.
trans-unit.target: 示例名字都是狗狗和猫咪最常用的名字。换成适合你家宠物的名字吧：食物名、著名角色，或者与你们遇见它的地方有关的名字。

trans-unit.source: Does it work for any animal?
Yes. The wheel only holds names, so it works for a dog, a cat, a rabbit, a fish or a horse.
trans-unit.target: 适用。转盘上只有名字，所以狗、猫、兔子、鱼或马都可以用。

trans-unit.source: Can the kids spin it on their own device?
trans-unit.target: 孩子们可以在自己的设备上转吗？

trans-unit.source: Publish the wheel as a read-only link and it opens in any browser, with no account.
trans-unit.target: 把转盘发布为只读链接，任何浏览器都能打开，无需账户。

trans-unit.source: Party Games Wheel | Random Party Game Picker
trans-unit.target: 派对游戏转盘 | 随机选择派对游戏

trans-unit.source: Spin the party games wheel and keep the fun going: charades, musical chairs, hot potato and more. Free for birthdays, sleepovers and family parties.
trans-unit.target: 转动派对游戏转盘，让欢乐继续：你比我猜、抢椅子、烫手山芋等等。免费用于生日会、睡衣派对和家庭聚会。

trans-unit.source: The party slows down every time someone asks “what shall we play now?”. Put the games on the wheel, let the birthday child spin, and the next game starts without a debate.
trans-unit.target: 每当有人问“接下来玩什么？”，派对就会冷场。把游戏放上转盘，让寿星来转，下一个游戏马上开始，不用争论。

trans-unit.source: Every game on the stock wheel works with what is already in the room: some music, a few chairs, a cushion to pass around. Swap in the games your guests actually know and love.
trans-unit.target: 示例转盘上的每个游戏都只需要房间里现成的东西：一点音乐、几把椅子、一个可以传递的靠垫。换成你的客人熟悉和喜爱的游戏吧。

trans-unit.source: Put the wheel on the TV or a projector and turn on the countdown and the winner effects. The spin itself becomes part of the entertainment, especially for younger children.
trans-unit.target: 把转盘投到电视或投影仪上，打开倒计时和中奖特效。转动本身就成了节目的一部分，小朋友们尤其喜欢。

trans-unit.source: Is it suitable for kids’ parties?
Yes. Everything on the stock wheel is suitable for children, and you can replace the games with ones that fit the age of your guests.
trans-unit.target: 适合。示例转盘上的所有内容都适合儿童，你也可以换成适合客人年龄的游戏。

trans-unit.source: Can I stop a game from coming up twice?
trans-unit.target: 可以避免同一个游戏出现两次吗？

trans-unit.source: Remove each game after it has been played and the wheel only offers the ones that are left.
trans-unit.target: 每玩完一个游戏就把它移除，转盘只会给出剩下的游戏。

trans-unit.source: What to Study Wheel | Random Study Subject Picker
trans-unit.target: 学什么转盘 | 随机选择复习科目

trans-unit.source: Can’t decide what to revise first? Spin the study wheel for your next subject and start studying instead of planning. Free, no signup.
trans-unit.target: 不知道先复习哪科？转动学习转盘决定下一科，直接开始学习而不是做计划。免费，无需注册。

trans-unit.source: Planning what to revise can take longer than the revision itself. Put your subjects on the wheel, spin, and start on whatever it picks for the next study session. The decision is made; now only the work is left.
trans-unit.target: 规划复习什么，可能比复习本身还花时间。把你的科目放上转盘，转一下，下一轮学习就从它选中的科目开始。决定已经做好了，剩下的只有学习。

trans-unit.source: Pair the wheel with a timer: spin, study that subject for 25 minutes, take a break, spin again. Remove a subject once it is covered for the day, so the wheel keeps pushing you through the whole list.
trans-unit.target: 把转盘和计时器搭配使用：转一下，学这科 25 分钟，休息，再转。某科当天学完就把它移除，转盘会推着你把整份清单都学完。

trans-unit.source: The subject you keep avoiding is usually the one that needs the most time. Add it to the wheel twice and it will come up more often.
trans-unit.target: 你一直在逃避的那一科，通常最需要时间。把它在转盘上添加两次，它就会更常出现。

trans-unit.source: Can I use it for study groups?
Yes. Share your screen or publish the wheel as a link, and the group spins to decide which topic to go through next.
trans-unit.target: 可以。共享屏幕或把转盘发布为链接，小组一起转，决定接下来学哪个主题。

trans-unit.source: Your wheel stays saved in your browser. Signing in syncs it across your devices.
trans-unit.target: 你的转盘会保存在浏览器中。登录后可在你的设备之间同步。

trans-unit.source: Random Hobby Generator | Spin for a New Hobby
trans-unit.target: 随机爱好生成器 | 转出一个新爱好

trans-unit.source: A free random hobby generator: spin the wheel for a new hobby to try this month, from baking and chess to pottery and birdwatching.
trans-unit.target: 免费的随机爱好生成器：转动转盘，选出本月要尝试的新爱好，从烘焙、国际象棋到陶艺和观鸟。

trans-unit.source: Wanting a new hobby is easy; picking one is where it stalls. Spin the wheel, commit to trying whatever it lands on for a month, and find out whether you like it by doing it rather than reading about it.
trans-unit.target: 想要一个新爱好很容易，难的是选一个。转动转盘，承诺把结果试一个月，通过亲自去做而不是看资料来发现自己喜不喜欢。

trans-unit.source: One month is long enough to get past the awkward start and short enough not to feel like a commitment. When the month is over, remove the hobby from the wheel and spin for the next one.
trans-unit.target: 一个月足以度过笨拙的起步期，又短到不会让人觉得是负担。一个月结束后，把这个爱好从转盘移除，再转出下一个。

trans-unit.source: Add the ones you keep thinking about
trans-unit.target: 加入你一直惦记的爱好

trans-unit.source: The best hobby list is the one you already have in your head: the instrument in the cupboard, the class a friend keeps mentioning. Put those on the wheel next to the stock ideas.
trans-unit.target: 最好的爱好清单就是你脑子里已有的那份：柜子里的乐器、朋友总在提的课程。把它们和示例放在一起加到转盘上。

trans-unit.source: Most of the stock hobbies can be started with very little. Replace any of them with ones that fit your budget and your space.
trans-unit.target: 大多数示例爱好只需很少投入就能开始。把不适合你预算或空间的换掉即可。

trans-unit.source: Can I use it with a partner or friends?
trans-unit.target: 可以和伴侣或朋友一起用吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes — spin it together and try the same hobby as a group, or keep one wheel each.
trans-unit.target: 可以——一起转，作为一个小组尝试同一个爱好，或者每人保留一个自己的转盘。

trans-unit.source: What to Do When Bored Wheel | Boredom Buster Spinner
trans-unit.target: 无聊时做什么转盘 | 消除无聊的点子

trans-unit.source: Bored and out of ideas? Spin the boredom wheel for something to do right now, indoors or out. Free, no signup, and you can add your own ideas.
trans-unit.target: 无聊又没主意？转动消除无聊转盘，找到一件马上就能做的事，室内室外都行。免费，无需注册，还能添加自己的点子。

trans-unit.source: What to Do When Bored Wheel
Boredom is rarely a lack of things to do — it is not being able to pick one. Spin the wheel, do the first thing it says for ten minutes, and see where it takes you.
trans-unit.target: 无聊很少是因为没事可做，而是选不出要做哪件。转动转盘，照它说的做十分钟，看看会发生什么。

trans-unit.source: Everything on the stock wheel can be started right now, without buying anything or going far. The rule that makes it work: whatever comes up, you do it for at least ten minutes.
trans-unit.target: 示例转盘上的所有事情都能立刻开始，不用买东西也不用走远。让它奏效的规则是：不管转出什么，至少做十分钟。

trans-unit.source: Build a version for the school holidays with activities your children can do on their own. Letting them spin it turns “I’m bored” into a game rather than a complaint.
trans-unit.target: 做一个寒暑假版本，放上孩子们能独立完成的活动。让他们自己转，“我好无聊”就从抱怨变成了游戏。

trans-unit.source: Can I make an indoor and an outdoor version?
trans-unit.target: 可以做室内和室外两个版本吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Keep two wheels and spin the one that suits the weather.
trans-unit.target: 可以。保存两个转盘，根据天气转对应的那个。

trans-unit.source: The Android app works without a connection, and on the web the page keeps working once it has loaded.
trans-unit.target: Android 应用无需联网即可使用；在网页上，页面加载后也能继续使用。

trans-unit.source: Self-Care Wheel | Random Self-Care Ideas Spinner
trans-unit.target: 自我关怀转盘 | 随机自我关怀点子

trans-unit.source: Spin the self-care wheel for one small, kind thing to do for yourself today. Free, private, and you can fill it with the ideas that help you most.
trans-unit.target: 转动自我关怀转盘，今天为自己做一件温柔的小事。免费、私密，还可以放上最能帮到你的点子。

trans-unit.source: On a hard day even choosing how to look after yourself can feel like one decision too many. Spin the wheel and let it pick one small thing — a glass of water, a walk, an early night. Small is the point.
trans-unit.target: 在艰难的日子里，连选择怎样照顾自己都可能是多余的负担。转动转盘，让它帮你选一件小事——一杯水、一次散步、早点睡觉。小，正是关键。

trans-unit.source: Fill it with what works for you
The stock ideas are simple and universal. Replace them with the things that genuinely help you: a particular song, a place you like to walk, a person you like to call.
trans-unit.target: 示例点子简单通用。换成真正能帮到你的事：某首特定的歌、你喜欢散步的地方、你喜欢打电话的人。

trans-unit.source: Your wheel is saved only in your own browser. Nothing leaves your device unless you choose to sign in and sync it, or publish it as a link.
trans-unit.target: 你的转盘只保存在你自己的浏览器中。除非你选择登录同步或将其发布为链接，否则任何内容都不会离开你的设备。

trans-unit.source: Is this a replacement for professional help?
No. It is a small everyday tool. If you are struggling, please talk to someone you trust or to a health professional.
trans-unit.target: 不能。它只是一个日常小工具。如果你正经历困难，请和你信任的人或专业医护人员聊一聊。

trans-unit.source: Can I use it every day?
Yes. The wheel stays saved, so you can spin it each morning or whenever you need it.
trans-unit.target: 可以。转盘会一直保存，你可以每天早上或需要时转一转。

trans-unit.source: What to Cook Wheel | Random Dinner Recipe Picker
trans-unit.target: 做什么菜转盘 | 随机选晚餐菜谱

trans-unit.source: Don’t know what to cook tonight? Spin the wheel for a dish and start cooking. Free, and you can fill it with the recipes you actually make.
trans-unit.target: 不知道今晚做什么菜？转动转盘选一道菜，开始下厨吧。免费，还可以放上你真正会做的菜谱。

trans-unit.source: Deciding what to cook is the part of cooking nobody enjoys. Put the dishes you know how to make on the wheel, spin it while the pan heats up, and dinner is decided.
trans-unit.target: 决定做什么菜，是做饭中没人喜欢的环节。把你会做的菜放上转盘，趁锅热的时候转一下，晚餐就定了。

trans-unit.source: The stock dishes are everyday classics. Replace them with your own repertoire, and the wheel becomes a way to stop cooking the same three meals every week.
trans-unit.target: 示例菜品都是日常经典。换成你自己的拿手菜，转盘就能帮你摆脱每周都做同样三道菜的循环。

trans-unit.source: Spin seven times, removing each dish as it comes up, and you have a week of dinners — and a shopping list to go with it.
trans-unit.target: 转七次，每道菜出现后就移除，你就有了一周的晚餐安排——还有配套的购物清单。

trans-unit.source: Is this different from the “what to eat” wheel?
trans-unit.target: 和“吃什么”转盘有什么不同？

trans-unit.source: Yes. This one is for cooking at home; the what to eat wheel is for choosing a type of food or a restaurant.
trans-unit.target: 是的。这个用于在家做饭；“吃什么”转盘用于选择菜系或餐厅。

trans-unit.source: Can the whole family add dishes?
trans-unit.target: 全家人都可以添加菜品吗？

trans-unit.source: Share the wheel as a read-only link to show the list, and add the dishes everybody asks for.
trans-unit.target: 把转盘分享为只读链接展示清单，再把大家都想吃的菜加进去。

trans-unit.source: Random Superpower Generator | Spin for a Superpower
trans-unit.target: 随机超能力生成器 | 转出你的超能力

trans-unit.source: Spin the random superpower generator: flight, invisibility, time travel and more. Free for kids’ games, story writing, drawing and icebreakers.
trans-unit.target: 转动随机超能力生成器：飞行、隐身、时间旅行等等。免费用于儿童游戏、故事写作、绘画和破冰活动。

trans-unit.source: Everyone has an answer to “which superpower would you pick?”. The wheel takes the choice away: spin, get your power, and then explain what you would do with it.
trans-unit.target: 每个人都能回答“你会选哪种超能力？”。转盘替你做选择：转一下，拿到你的超能力，然后说说你会用它做什么。

trans-unit.source: Use it for a storytelling round where each player gets a power, a drawing challenge for a new hero, or a creative writing prompt. It is also a reliable icebreaker for classes and teams.
trans-unit.target: 可以用来玩每人获得一种能力的故事接龙、设计新英雄的绘画挑战，或作为创意写作的题目。它也是班级和团队里靠谱的破冰游戏。

trans-unit.source: Show a second wheel next to it with a weakness for each hero. A hero who can fly but is afraid of heights makes a much better story.
trans-unit.target: 在旁边再放一个转盘，给每位英雄一个弱点。会飞却恐高的英雄，故事会精彩得多。

trans-unit.source: Yes. Project it on the board and let each student spin their power before a writing or drawing task.
trans-unit.target: 适合。把它投影到黑板上，在写作或绘画任务前让每个学生转出自己的超能力。

trans-unit.source: Can I add my own powers?
trans-unit.target: 可以添加自己的超能力吗？

trans-unit.source: Copy the wheel and add as many as you like; every entry is editable.
trans-unit.target: 复制转盘，想加多少都行；每个条目都可以编辑。

trans-unit.source: Charades Ideas Wheel | Random Charades Generator
trans-unit.target: 你比我猜转盘 | 随机表演题目生成器

trans-unit.source: A free charades generator: spin the wheel for something to act out, with no words and no sounds. Great for family game nights and parties.
trans-unit.target: 免费的你比我猜生成器：转动转盘得到一个表演题目，不许说话也不许出声。非常适合家庭游戏夜和派对。

trans-unit.source: The hardest part of charades is thinking up what to act. Let the wheel do it: the player spins where only they can see the phone, gets their prompt, and starts acting.
trans-unit.target: 你比我猜最难的是想题目。交给转盘吧：表演者在只有自己能看到手机的地方转一下，拿到题目就开始表演。

trans-unit.source: Spin on the actor’s phone rather than the big screen, so only they see the result. Remove each prompt once it has been guessed and the round never repeats.
trans-unit.target: 在表演者的手机上转，而不是在大屏幕上，这样只有他能看到结果。题目被猜中后就移除，这一轮就永远不会重复。

trans-unit.source: Keep a wheel for films, one for animals and one for jobs, and let the team pick the theme before the actor spins. Up to four wheels can be shown side by side.
trans-unit.target: 准备电影、动物和职业三个转盘，让队伍在表演者转动之前先选主题。最多可以并排显示四个转盘。

trans-unit.source: Yes. The stock prompts are family friendly, and you can replace them with things younger children can act out easily.
trans-unit.target: 适合。示例题目老少皆宜，你也可以换成小朋友容易表演的内容。

trans-unit.source: Can I use it with teams?
Yes. Put the team names on a second wheel to decide who goes next.
trans-unit.target: 可以。把队名放到第二个转盘上，决定下一个轮到谁。

trans-unit.source: Random Job Generator | Spin for a Random Job
trans-unit.target: 随机职业生成器 | 转出一个职业

trans-unit.source: A free random job generator wheel for role-play, writing, career days and guessing games. Spin for a job and step into the role.
trans-unit.target: 免费的随机职业生成器，适用于角色扮演、写作、职业日和猜谜游戏。转出一个职业，进入角色吧。

trans-unit.source: Astronaut, detective, vet: a random job is a surprisingly good starting point. Spin for a role in a game of pretend, a character for a story, or a topic for a career-day talk.
trans-unit.target: 宇航员、侦探、兽医：随机职业是一个出奇好用的起点。转出过家家游戏里的角色、故事里的人物，或职业日演讲的主题。

trans-unit.source: One player spins in secret and answers questions in character until the others guess the job. It works as a warm-up for classes, teams and language lessons.
trans-unit.target: 一名玩家偷偷转一下，然后以角色身份回答问题，直到其他人猜出职业。适合作为班级、团队和语言课的热身活动。

trans-unit.source: Replace the stock jobs with the careers your class is exploring, and let each student spin the one they will research and present.
trans-unit.target: 把示例职业换成你的班级正在了解的职业，让每个学生转出自己要研究和介绍的那一个。

trans-unit.source: Is it useful for language lessons?
Yes. Guessing a job through questions is a classic speaking exercise, and the wheel keeps the prompts random.
trans-unit.target: 有。通过提问猜职业是经典的口语练习，转盘能让题目保持随机。

trans-unit.source: Copy the wheel and add as many as you like.
trans-unit.target: 复制转盘，想加多少都行。

trans-unit.source: Writing Prompt Wheel | Random Story Prompt Generator
trans-unit.target: 写作灵感转盘 | 随机故事开头生成器

trans-unit.source: Spin the writing prompt wheel for a random story starter and start writing before you can overthink it. Free for writers, teachers and students.
trans-unit.target: 转动写作灵感转盘获得随机故事开头，在想太多之前开始写。免费供写作者、教师和学生使用。

trans-unit.source: A blank page gets easier with a constraint. Spin the wheel, take the prompt it lands on, and write the first line straight away — the prompt is a door, not a rule.
trans-unit.target: 有了限制，白纸就没那么难了。转动转盘，接受它停下的题目，立刻写下第一句——题目是一扇门，而不是规则。

trans-unit.source: Project the wheel and spin once for the whole class, or let each student spin their own. Removing each prompt after it is used means nobody writes the same story as their neighbour.
trans-unit.target: 投影转盘，为全班转一次，或者让每个学生自己转。每个题目用过后就移除，就不会有人和同桌写同一个故事。

trans-unit.source: Show a wheel of prompts next to a wheel of genres — mystery, comedy, science fiction — and a third for the setting. Three spins make a prompt no list can give you.
trans-unit.target: 把题目转盘和类型转盘（悬疑、喜剧、科幻）并排显示，再加一个场景转盘。三次转动得到的题目，是任何单一列表都给不了的。

trans-unit.source: Can I add my own prompts?
trans-unit.target: 可以添加自己的题目吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Copy the wheel and replace or add prompts; the wheel stays saved for your next session.
trans-unit.target: 可以。复制转盘，替换或添加题目；转盘会保存下来，供下次使用。

trans-unit.source: Yes. There is no account, no subscription and no student data involved.
trans-unit.target: 免费。无需账户，无需订阅，也不涉及学生数据。

trans-unit.source: What to Wear Wheel | Random Outfit Challenge
trans-unit.target: 穿什么转盘 | 随机穿搭挑战

trans-unit.source: Can’t decide what to wear? Spin the outfit wheel for a style challenge: a colour, a theme, a piece you never wear. Free, no signup.
trans-unit.target: 不知道穿什么？转动穿搭转盘接受风格挑战：一个颜色、一个主题、一件从不穿的单品。免费，无需注册。

trans-unit.source: A wardrobe full of clothes and nothing to wear. The wheel will not dress you, but it gives you a rule — all black, something red, stripes — and a rule is usually all it takes to get dressed.
trans-unit.target: 衣柜满满却没衣服穿。转盘不会帮你穿衣，但会给你一条规则——全黑、一件红色单品、条纹——而有了规则，穿衣通常就不难了。

trans-unit.source: The stock entries are prompts rather than outfits, so they work whatever is in your wardrobe. Spin in the morning, build the look around the prompt, and you have saved ten minutes.
trans-unit.target: 示例条目是提示而不是具体搭配，所以适用于任何衣橱。早上转一下，围绕提示搭配造型，就能省下十分钟。

trans-unit.source: Outfit challenges are a popular format for stories and short videos. Spin on camera, then show the result — the winner card can save an image of the spin for your post.
trans-unit.target: 穿搭挑战是快拍和短视频中很受欢迎的形式。对着镜头转，再展示结果——中奖卡片可以保存这次转动的图片，方便你发帖。

trans-unit.source: Can I put my actual clothes on the wheel?
trans-unit.target: 可以把自己的衣服放到转盘上吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Add your tops, trousers or shoes as entries — or keep three wheels side by side, one for each.
trans-unit.target: 可以。把上衣、裤子或鞋子作为条目添加进去——或者并排放三个转盘，每类一个。

trans-unit.source: Does it work on my phone?
Yes, in any mobile browser, and as an Android app.
trans-unit.target: 能用，任何手机浏览器都可以，也有 Android 应用。

trans-unit.source: What Game to Play Wheel | Random Video Game Picker
trans-unit.target: 玩什么游戏转盘 | 随机选择电子游戏

trans-unit.source: Too many games in your library? Spin the wheel to pick what to play tonight — by genre or by title. Free, and a great segment on stream.
trans-unit.target: 游戏库里游戏太多？转动转盘，按类型或标题决定今晚玩什么。免费，也很适合作为直播环节。

trans-unit.source: A library of a hundred games and an evening spent scrolling through it. Put the genres — or the actual titles — on the wheel, spin once, and play whatever it picks.
trans-unit.target: 游戏库里有一百款游戏，一晚上都在翻来翻去。把类型——或具体的游戏名——放上转盘，转一次，转到什么就玩什么。

trans-unit.source: The stock wheel uses genres; the version that really works holds the titles you own and never started. Paste the list in one go and let the wheel clear your backlog one spin at a time.
trans-unit.target: 示例转盘用的是游戏类型；真正好用的版本，是放上你买了却从没开始玩的游戏。一次粘贴整份清单，让转盘一次一次地帮你清空待玩清单。

trans-unit.source: Spin live and let the wheel pick the next game in front of your viewers. The countdown, the sounds and the winner effects make the spin a small show of its own.
trans-unit.target: 在直播中转动，让转盘当着观众的面选出下一款游戏。倒计时、音效和中奖特效让每次转动都像一场小表演。

trans-unit.source: Can I use it as a stream overlay?
trans-unit.target: 可以作为直播叠加层使用吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Capture the browser window in OBS or Streamlabs and spin it live.
trans-unit.target: 可以。在 OBS 或 Streamlabs 中捕获浏览器窗口，直播时转动即可。

trans-unit.source: Add their suggestions to the wheel before the spin — adding a title more than once gives it better odds.
trans-unit.target: 在转动前把观众的建议加到转盘上——同一游戏添加多次，被选中的概率就更高。

trans-unit.source: Heads or Tails Wheel | Online Coin Flip Spinner
trans-unit.target: 正反面转盘 | 在线抛硬币

trans-unit.source: Flip a coin online with the heads or tails wheel: two sides, one spin, and a fair result everyone can watch. Free, no coin required.
trans-unit.target: 用正反面转盘在线抛硬币：两面，一次转动，结果公平且人人可见。免费，无需硬币。

trans-unit.source: No coin in your pocket? Spin the wheel instead. Heads and tails share the wheel equally, and the result comes from your browser’s cryptographic random source — as fair as a coin, and nobody can drop it.
trans-unit.target: 口袋里没有硬币？转转盘吧。正面和反面平分整个转盘，结果来自浏览器的加密随机源——和硬币一样公平，而且没人会把它弄掉。

trans-unit.source: Each side is exactly half of the wheel, so the odds are exactly fifty-fifty. Unlike a real coin toss, nobody can claim it was thrown badly or landed on the edge.
trans-unit.target: 每一面正好占转盘的一半，所以概率就是五五开。和真的抛硬币不同，没人能说抛得不好或硬币立起来了。

trans-unit.source: Keep the winners list open and every result is recorded on screen, which makes a best-of-three or best-of-five easy to follow.
trans-unit.target: 打开中奖名单，每次结果都会记录在屏幕上，三局两胜或五局三胜都很容易追踪。

trans-unit.source: Yes. Heads and tails have the same number of slices, all the same size, and the spin uses a cryptographic random source.
trans-unit.target: 是的。正面和反面的扇区数量相同，大小也都一样，转动使用加密随机源。

trans-unit.source: Can I use it to decide who starts a game?
trans-unit.target: 可以用它决定谁先开始吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes — that is one of the most common uses, along with choosing ends in sports matches.
trans-unit.target: 可以——这是最常见的用法之一，另一个常见用法是体育比赛中选边。

trans-unit.source: Punishment Wheel | Forfeit Spinner for Games & Streams
trans-unit.target: 惩罚转盘 | 游戏与直播惩罚生成器

trans-unit.source: Lost the round? Spin the punishment wheel for a harmless forfeit. Free for game nights, parties and live streams, and every forfeit is editable.
trans-unit.target: 这一轮输了？转动惩罚转盘，领取一个无伤大雅的惩罚。免费用于游戏夜、派对和直播，每个惩罚都可以编辑。

trans-unit.source: A game is more fun when losing costs something. Put a few harmless forfeits on the wheel, and whoever loses the round spins for theirs — in front of everyone, with no way to negotiate.
trans-unit.target: 输了要付出点代价，游戏才更好玩。在转盘上放几个无伤大雅的惩罚，谁输了这一轮就当着大家的面转出自己的惩罚，没得商量。

trans-unit.source: The best forfeits are embarrassing, not unpleasant: a song, a dance, an accent. The stock wheel sticks to those, and everything on it is safe for a family evening.
trans-unit.target: 最好的惩罚是让人尴尬而不是难受：唱首歌、跳段舞、学个口音。示例转盘只包含这类内容，全都适合家庭聚会。

trans-unit.source: Streamers use punishment wheels for lost matches and chat challenges. Spin live, and the fire or fireworks effect turns every loss into a moment.
trans-unit.target: 主播们常用惩罚转盘来应对输掉的比赛和观众挑战。直播时转动，火焰或烟花特效让每次失败都成为名场面。

trans-unit.source: Can I add my own forfeits?
trans-unit.target: 可以添加自己的惩罚吗？

trans-unit.source: Yes. Copy the wheel and replace any forfeit; keep them light enough that everybody still wants to play.
trans-unit.target: 可以。复制转盘并替换任意惩罚；保持足够轻松，让每个人都还想继续玩。

trans-unit.source: Can I give the mild ones better odds?
trans-unit.target: 可以让轻松的惩罚概率更高吗？

trans-unit.source: Add a forfeit more than once and it takes more slices, so it comes up more often.
trans-unit.target: 把某个惩罚多添加几次，它会占据更多扇区，出现得更频繁。

trans-unit.source: Spin the random music genre wheel for tonight’s playlist, a party theme or something new to listen to. Free, and every genre is editable.
trans-unit.target: 转动音乐类型转盘，决定今晚的歌单、派对主题或新的聆听方向。免费，每种类型都可编辑。

trans-unit.source: Your listening habits are probably stuck in the same three genres. Spin the wheel, commit to an evening of whatever it picks, and find the album you would never have chosen yourself.
trans-unit.target: 你的听歌习惯可能一直停留在那三种类型。转动转盘，花一个晚上听它选中的类型，发现一张你自己永远不会选的专辑。

trans-unit.source: Spin for the theme of a party playlist, the genre of the next karaoke round, or the style a band has to play the next song in.
trans-unit.target: 转出派对歌单的主题、下一轮卡拉OK的类型，或乐队下一首歌必须演奏的风格。

trans-unit.target: 转出一种类型后，在旁边放第二个转盘，列出它的子类型或年代。两次转动就能把你从“爵士”带到从未到过的地方。
